summary: Russian forces launched a severe multi-domain attack on October 13, highlighted by a ballistic missile strike on a residential building in Kyiv and deadly artillery fire on civilians in Kupyansk. Russia delivered approximately 200 reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel, signaling an impending massive drone and missile campaign against Ukrainian cities. Meanwhile, Ukrainian air defenses intercepted several drones, but Russian tactical advances near Bilytske and Novyi Donbas indicate continued pressure along the eastern front.
key_points: Ballistic missiles struck Kyiv, hitting a nine-story residential building and transport infrastructure without prior warning. (Source: @eRadarrua/122730)
Russian forces fired on civilians during an evacuation in Kupyansk, causing casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/84640)
An explosion destroyed a fuel tank at the Novoshakhtinsk oil terminal in Rostov region. (Source: @eRadarrua/122747)
Russia delivered around 200 reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel for upcoming strikes. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703)
Russian troops advanced tactically near Bilytske, Dorozhne, Novyi Donbas, and Matyasheve. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23903)
Deadly Russian strikes hit residential buildings in Kharkiv and an educational institution in Rivne. (Source: @UkraineNow/84630)
Two Russian "Rassvet" satellites rapidly lost altitude and threatened to burn up. (Source: @UkraineNow/84635)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a severe multi-domain attack on October 13, highlighted by a ballistic missile strike on a residential building in Kyiv and deadly artillery fire on civilians in Kupyansk. Russia delivered approximately 200 reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel, signaling an impending massive drone and missile campaign against Ukrainian cities. Meanwhile, Ukrainian air defenses intercepted several drones, but Russian tactical advances near Bilytske and Novyi Donbas indicate continued pressure along the eastern front.

points: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv around 22:40 on October 13, hitting a nine-story residential building in the Lisovyi massif, as well as transport infrastructure in Dniprovskyi district and a warehouse in Desnianskyi district. Kharkiv also saw a deadly strike on a residential building with three fatalities and ten wounded. (Source: @UkraineNow/84630, @eRadarrua/122730, @eRadarrua/122728, @UkraineNow/84647)

In Rivne, twenty people were casualties following a Russian strike on an educational institution, while Ukrainian air defense successfully intercepted a drone over Lviv oblast, though it crashed onto a residential building in Muruvane, causing fires. (Source: @UkraineNow/84637, @UkraineNow/84630)

Russian forces launched a massive wave of reactive Shahed and Geran-5 drones across western and central Ukraine, targeting Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Ternopil oblasts, with multiple impacts and crashes reported in residential areas of Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76746, @mon1tor_ua/76748, @mon1tor_ua/76769, @mon1tor_ua/76771)

Ukrainian military monitored Russian preparations for a potential launch of approximately 30 ballistic missiles over the next two days targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Poltava, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts, following the delivery of roughly 200 additional reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703)

An explosion occurred at a fuel storage tank at the Novoshakhtinsk oil product terminal in Rostov region, Russia, on October 13, highlighting ongoing vulnerabilities in Russian rear logistics and infrastructure near the border. (Source: @eRadarrua/122747)

Russian authorities organized and then attacked civilians during an evacuation in Kupyansk, using mortars and artillery fire on groups containing women and children, resulting in casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/84640)

Russian forces deployed an additional batch of approximately 200 reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel to sustain long-range strike campaigns against Ukrainian civilian infrastructure and energy grids. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703)

Russian air defense and radar networks failed to prevent the loss of two "Rassvet" satellites (nos. 17 and 23), which are rapidly losing altitude and threatening to burn up in the atmosphere, showing gaps in space asset maintenance. (Source: @UkraineNow/84635)

Russian forces made tactical advances in the Donetsk region, specifically pushing near Bilytske, Dorozhne, Novyi Donbas, and Matyasheve, according to updated frontline mapping. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23903, @DeepStateUA/23904)

In Kupyansk, Russian troops organized civilian evacuations but immediately subjected the fleeing population to mortar and artillery fire, causing casualties among women and children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84640)

Russian drone reconnaissance and strike systems were actively operating along the contact line, with multiple reactive Shahed drones detected over the Dnipro region and Kirovohrad oblast targeting infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76746, @eRadarrua/122710)

Russian forces continued to shell positions and civilian areas in the Donbas, attempting to consolidate gains near newly captured localities like Novyi Donbas and Bilytske. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23903)

Russian forces launched Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones from northern launch points, including Bryansk and Chernihiv oblasts, targeting Kyiv and surrounding regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76746, @mon1tor_ua/76748)

Kyiv suffered a severe ballistic missile strike late on October 13, with hits on residential buildings and critical transport infrastructure in the Dniprovskyi and Desnianskyi districts. (Source: @eRadarrua/122730, @UkraineNow/84630)

Ukrainian air defense was active over the capital, but Russian ballistic missiles struck before partner warning systems could detect the launches due to unfavorable weather conditions. (Source: @eRadarrua/122670, @eRadarrua/122745)
Russian Shahed drones repeatedly crossed into Ukrainian airspace from the north and west, attempting to bypass air defenses over Kyiv and Zhytomyr oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/86187, @kpszsu/86196)
Russian forces delivered a fresh shipment of about 200 reactive Shahed drones to Crimea and Orel to sustain attacks on southern and western Ukrainian regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703)

Ukrainian air defense intercepted a drone over the Black Sea and near Lviv oblast, while multiple Russian drones were tracked over Odesa, Mykolaiv, and Vinnytsia oblasts heading toward inland targets. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76746, @kpszsu/86184)
Russian naval and coastal assets in the Black Sea remained on alert, with drone activity originating from Crimea and the southern maritime direction persisting. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76746)

Russian attempts to advance along the southern axis were met with localized resistance, though drone warfare remained the primary tool for long-range strikes on Ukrainian rear areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703)

Russia launched a coordinated mixed missile and drone attack on October 13, using ballistic missiles against Kyiv and approximately 200 reactive Shahed drones across multiple waves targeting western, central, and southern Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/122703, @eRadarrua/122730)

Ukrainian air defense forces successfully intercepted several Geran-5 and reactive Shahed drones over Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Ternopil oblasts, though some evaded defenses and struck residential areas in Khmelnytskyi and Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76748, @mon1tor_ua/76767, @UkraineNow/84630)

The United States' early warning satellites failed to detect the Russian ballistic missile launches on Kyiv due to cloud cover, leaving Ukraine without advance warning from partners. (Source: @eRadarrua/122670)

Russia's "Rassvet" satellite constellation experienced orbital decay, with two units rapidly losing altitude and threatening to re-enter the atmosphere, indicating potential degradation of Russian space-based assets. (Source: @UkraineNow/84635)
